identifying_description: Woman's ensemble comprised of: (a) long sleeve, scoop neck tan linen gauze top with supplementary weft patterning, and white cotton eyelet and tan cotton lace insertions, zipper and hook and eye closure at back, label at center back (gray text on white label) "RODARTE"; (b) skirt of checkered synthetic plain weave and synthetic gauze weave with supplementary weft patterning in shades of orange, blue, and brown, side zip closure at proper left, label at back (gray text on white label): "RODARTE"; (c) stockings of peach synthetic net with metallic thread and cotton embroidery (satin stitch) and sequins and beads, zipper and hook and eye closure at back, label at back (gray text on white label): "RODARTE"
